note.en: Servos 30 and 31 are the neck (left photo). Servos 32, 33 and 34 sit inside the head shell (right photo).
note.zh: 30、31 是颈部舵机（左图）；32、33、34 装在头壳里面（右图）。

note.en: Left and right are from Duck’s perspective. Its left leg is IDs 10–14, on the right half of this front-view photo. The other leg is dimmed.
note.zh: 左右以小鸭自身为准。左腿是 ID 10–14，对应这张正面照片右半边的编号牌；另一条腿已调暗。

note.en: Left and right are from Duck’s perspective. Its right leg is IDs 20–24, on the left half of this front-view photo. The other leg is dimmed.
note.zh: 左右以小鸭自身为准。右腿是 ID 20–24，对应这张正面照片左半边的编号牌；另一条腿已调暗。

pose.en: From above, turn the leg until it points straight ahead, parallel to the dashed centre line.
pose.zh: 从上往下看，把腿转到正对前方，与虚线（机身中线）平行。

pose.en: From the front, the leg hangs straight down: not leaning out or in.
pose.zh: 从正面看，腿笔直垂下，不向外撇也不向内收。

pose.en: From the side, align the upper leg’s top edge with the horizontal dashed line and the lower leg with the vertical line. They form a right angle, not a straight standing leg.
pose.zh: 从侧面看，大腿连杆上沿对齐水平虚线，小腿对齐竖直虚线，摆成直角，不是把整条腿拉直。

pose.en: From the side, align the lower leg with the vertical dashed line. Keep it square to the horizontal upper leg; do not straighten both links into one line.
pose.zh: 从侧面看，小腿对齐竖直虚线，与上方水平连杆成直角，不要把大腿和小腿拉成一直线。

pose.en: From the side, the foot is flat: the sole is level and square to the leg.
pose.zh: 从侧面看，脚掌放平，脚底水平、与小腿垂直。

pose.en: From above, turn the leg until it points straight ahead, parallel to the dashed centre line.
pose.zh: 从上往下看，把腿转到正对前方，与虚线（机身中线）平行。

pose.en: From the front, the leg hangs straight down: not leaning out or in.
pose.zh: 从正面看，腿笔直垂下，不向外撇也不向内收。

pose.en: From the side, align the upper leg’s top edge with the horizontal dashed line and the lower leg with the vertical line. They form a right angle, not a straight standing leg.
pose.zh: 从侧面看，大腿连杆上沿对齐水平虚线，小腿对齐竖直虚线，摆成直角，不是把整条腿拉直。

pose.en: From the side, align the lower leg with the vertical dashed line. Keep it square to the horizontal upper leg; do not straighten both links into one line.
pose.zh: 从侧面看，小腿对齐竖直虚线，与上方水平连杆成直角，不要把大腿和小腿拉成一直线。

pose.en: From the side, the foot is flat: the sole is level and square to the leg.
pose.zh: 从侧面看，脚掌放平，脚底水平、与小腿垂直。

pose.en: From the side, the neck stands straight up.
pose.zh: 从侧面看，脖子笔直向上。

pose.en: From the side, the head is level: its bottom edge is horizontal, not nodding up or down.
pose.zh: 从侧面看，头摆平：底边水平，不抬头也不低头。

pose.en: From above, the head faces straight ahead, in line with the dashed centre line.
pose.zh: 从上往下看，头正对前方，与虚线（机身中线）对齐。

pose.en: From the front, the head is level: not tilted to the left or right.
pose.zh: 从正面看，头摆正，不向左歪也不向右歪。

pose.en: Gently close the mouth to its natural closed position along the dashed mouth line. Do not squeeze the shell.
pose.zh: 把嘴轻轻合到自然闭合位置，对齐图示嘴缝，不要用力挤压外壳。
